meta_title: Bucky for iPhone and iPad: join the private beta
meta_description: Bucky for iPhone and iPad is in a private TestFlight beta. Leave your email and we'll invite your family when there's room.
alt_bucky: Bucky, the popcorn bucket, jumping with excitement
title: Bucky for iPhone and iPad
intro: Bucky on iPhone and iPad is in a private beta through Apple's TestFlight. Leave your email and we'll invite your family.
email_hint: Use the email of your Apple ID, so the invitation opens in TestFlight.
consent_text: I agree that Bucky keeps my email and these answers to invite me to the iPhone and iPad beta.
invalid_email: That email doesn't look quite right. Could you check it?
need_consent: Please tick the box above, so we're allowed to keep your email.
error_text: Something went wrong on our side, and your email wasn't saved. Please try again in a minute.
closed_text: Sign-ups open very soon. Please come back in a few days.
noscript: The form needs JavaScript. Please turn it on for this page.
success_text: We invite families in small groups. When it's your turn, Apple sends you an email from TestFlight with a link to install Bucky.
duplicate_text: This email signed up before, so there's nothing more to do. We'll write when it's your turn.
next1_text: Families join in small groups while we test. It can take a few days or weeks.
next2_text: Apple's free TestFlight app from the App Store runs beta apps. The email from Apple links to it.
next3_text: Open the invitation on your iPhone or iPad, tap Accept, then Install. Updates arrive in TestFlight.
privacy_short: We keep only what you type here, only for the beta, and never share it for marketing.
